title: Harness Pro landing page: historical first-pass assessment
status: Historical preview assessment, superseded by interaction-design.json and completion-audit.json. The completion entries below describe that earlier local study, not completion of the current product goal. Browser input and three-contact navigation are no longer the current scope.

source_scope.note: Local repository and existing local remote-tracking refs reviewed. No claim of a fresh remote fetch.

mission: Manage multiple agents across a laptop, home computer, and server through one dedicated touch companion.

product_decisions.decision: Round brings the current agent close; Pro brings the team into view.
product_decisions.implementation: Hero, multi-machine overview, agent strip, and round/Pro comparison.
Selecting or swiping agents changes only the device preview. Open is explicit; Return restores the previously opened agent.

product_decisions.decision: One finger: agents. Two: workspaces. Three: machines.
product_decisions.implementation: Pointer contact tracking and matching visible controls, arrow keys, and Shift/Alt shortcuts. Hardware gesture integration remains proposed.

product_decisions.decision: Questions gather in an attention queue and require a deliberate reply.
product_decisions.implementation: Choice, review, explicit Send, then a recipient-specific receipt. A different question clears the reviewed answer.

product_decisions.decision: Voice should produce a readable, scoped draft.
product_decisions.implementation: Sample voice note, editable text, visible recipient, empty-send protection, and explicit Send. This webpage never records audio.

product_decisions.decision: Carry useful context to the next agent.
product_decisions.implementation: Original excerpt, optional direction, chosen recipient, review, and delivery receipt.

product_decisions.decision: Browser use needs pointing and text entry.
product_decisions.implementation: Interactive local trackpad moves a monitor pointer, hit-tests a field, and exposes a virtual keyboard after selection. Proposed host/firmware mode.

product_decisions.decision: Reuse the character identity already present in Harness.
product_decisions.implementation: Twenty exact repository character assets; four selectable companions and working/attention/done/quiet states, plus reduced-motion CSS.
Three views rendered directly from Harness_pro9.step-derived meshes, with the actual wedge profile, rear geometry, and measured proportions.

desktop_feature_inventory: Native desktop and browser clients; real agent terminals with persisted panes, swarms, and tabs.
Multiple engines including Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Pi, Hermes, and OpenCode.
Search/jump to work, needs-input switching, models/profiles, worktrees, files and artifact viewers.
Linked local and remote machines; end-to-end-encrypted remote connections; processes/files stay on their hosts.
Daemon-backed sessions continue when the app closes; supported manager resume flows.
Read-only shares and comments, character roster, moods, quiet behavior, and voice.
Device integration negotiates optional questions, drafts, selection/carry, visits/return, forms, and settings.

source_evidence.used_for: Product mission, existing desktop capabilities, terminology, and engine coverage.
Device-to-desktop focus, scoped visits/return, guarded questions/forms, capability and connection revisions.
Negotiated capabilities, including visit, forms, selection, questions, voice drafts, refresh, and settings.
Round interaction model, charcoal/lilac identity, native recaps, deliberate attention, and reading without desktop focus changes.
Existing character collection and exact artwork.

720-square Pro direction and touch implementation boundaries. Habitat reads one contact; the separate standard LVGL path already reads two for pinch. The proposed three-level navigation is not claimed to be integrated.
Final supplied CAD dimensions, tilt, actual geometry, and limits of mechanical validation.

claim_boundaries: Landing page is a product preview, not a preorder or a shipment announcement.
New Pro overview, gesture hierarchy, trackpad, and virtual keyboard are proposed product behavior demonstrated locally.
The page sends no commands to real agents and requests no microphone access.
Current voice transcription uses a backend service and needs a network connection.
USB power is required. No battery, wireless operation, detachable dock, price, or delivery date is promised.
Physical multi-touch recognition, host pointer integration, keyboard ergonomics, and full mechanical fit are not validated by this webpage.

goal_completion_audit.evidence: Source inventory and feature assessment above.
Device visits, pending questions, forms, host capabilities, round firmware behavior.

goal_completion_audit.requirement: Use the larger square screen and richer gestures
goal_completion_audit.evidence: Agent grid, attention flows, original context alongside destination, and 1/2/3-contact gesture navigation in the local preview.

goal_completion_audit.requirement: Study and preserve the character design
goal_completion_audit.evidence: Existing round compositor image and 20 byte-identical assets from the current character collection.

goal_completion_audit.requirement: Manage multiple engines across all machines
goal_completion_audit.evidence: Six engines on three sample machines, search, workspace/machine filters, explicit desktop visit and return.

goal_completion_audit.requirement: Build the landing page for the final industrial design
goal_completion_audit.evidence: Repo-native Next.js /pro route, exact CAD-derived views, interactive preview, mobile layouts, production bundle.
Passing website tests, affected tests, lint, typechecked production build, desktop/tablet/mobile browser checks.
